title: Multiview screenshot endpoint (/ui/multiview)
description: POST /ui/multiview captures mesh from 8 orthogonal+diagonal viewpoints, composites into labeled 4x2 grid PNG. Enables 3D shape diagnosis from automation/AI workflows.
definition-of-done: Endpoint returns composite 4x2 PNG with 8 labeled views. Camera restores to original orbit after capture. Works with inline=true base64 mode.
testing-plan: Load hand_v12_posed.dsl, call /ui/multiview, verify 8 distinct views. Check camera restore. Test inline mode.
